items.title: 24.2.1 Mechanism of Evolution - Natural Selection (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of natural selection (PDF 217-218).

blocks.text: Charles Darwin (1809-1882), evolution ke jadeed nazariye ke bani, ne 1859 mein 'On the Origin of Species' shaya ki aur kaha ke evolution jandaron mein farq aur natural selection se hota hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaane: 1 Overproduction (bohat se aik jaise surmai jandar), 2 Variations (gehre, halke aur peele hare rang ke farq), 3 Struggle for survival (halke rang wale kaate hue: mar gaye ya nasl na barha sake), 4 Inheritance of adaptive traits (agli nasl mein sirf gehre hare). Khaanon ke darmiyan teer.
blocks.caption: Natural selection ke chaar nukte (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

items: Overproduction: jandaron mein kabhi poori na hone wali kaheen zyada nasl barhane ki salahiyat hai. Maada sea star har mausam mein taqreeban das lakh ande deti hai; agar sab zinda rahein aur aadhi maada ban kar das lakh ande dein to chand naslon mein samandar bhar jayen.
Variation: genetic farq ittefaqi mutations se paida hote aur koi do afraad bilkul aik jaise nahi hote. Farq faidamand, nuqsandeh ya bay-asar ho sakte hain, aur virasati farq bachchon mein jate hain.

Struggle for survival: kyunke wasail se kaheen zyada bachche paida hote hain, afraad zinda rehne ki jaddo jehad karte hain. Nuqsandeh farq wale mar jate ya nasl nahi barha pate, jab ke faidamand farq, yaani adaptive traits, wale kamyabi se nasl barhate hain.
Adaptive traits ki virasat: adaptive traits agli naslon mein jate hain, jab ke nuqsandeh khasiyatein kam hoti aur aakhir khatam ho jati hain.

blocks.title: Alfred Russel Wallace
blocks.text: British mahir-e-fitrat Alfred R. Wallace (1823-1913) ne evolution ke tareeqe ka apna, bohat milta julta nazariya banaya aur Darwin ko is ke baare mein khat likha. Jab 1858 mein dono nazariyat Linnean Society mein pesh hue to Wallace ne nazariya Darwin se mansoob karne par ittefaq kiya aur unhein 'On the Origin of Species' shaya karne par aamada kiya. Kitab Wallace ke khat ka saal 1957 chhapti hai; yeh 1858 tha.

blocks.prompt: Fitrat mein 'zinda rehne ki jaddo jehad' kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jandar dastiyab wasail se kaheen zyada bachche paida karte hain, is liye sab zinda nahi reh sakte.

items: Overproduction, variation, zinda rehne ki jaddo jehad, adaptive traits ki virasat.
Wallace bhi milte julte nazariye tak pohanche (1858 mein saath pesh).
